author: A Sentinel priest of Tu'whacca

#The Sinking

Yokuda was our homeland, west across the sea. It sank. Not all of it, the sailors say: there are islands still, and a desert, and sunken cities whose towers reach out of the water like hands.

We do not go back. We were told not to. We do not remember by whom.

#The Sword-Saints

The greatest of our ancestors were the sword-saints of Yokuda, who could split a falling leaf into a hundred pieces before it reached the ground, the stories say. What became of the leaves, the stories do not say.

If you find their tombs on those drowned islands, leave an offering. Leave two.
